$what: Provenance of effects-preset-vectors.json — empyrean's accept/reject DOCUMENT VECTORS for contract/schema/aurora-effects-preset.schema.json, vendored beside the tests that run them. test/formats/effects-preset-vectors.test.ts reads `empyrean.blob` from here as its pin of record and runs every case through parseEffectsPreset: each `expect: pass` document must parse and survive a save with nothing dropped, each `expect: fail` document must be refused by the SCHEMA (not by the filename/id rule, which the vectors do not exercise).
$why_a_sidecar: The same shape as src/core/formats/effects/aurora-effects-preset.schema.provenance.json, for the same reason: a pin recorded as prose in a test header goes stale without anything going red, because nothing hashes a comment. The hash lives HERE, once, and the test reads it.
$what_the_vectors_are_not: Value vectors. The schema is normative for SHAPE only (empyrean AURORA_EFFECTS_SCHEMA.md section 7.1), so a legal-shaped document carrying an out-of-range period or a shift of 9 PASSES here and is refused by the engine's own ensure with the measurement behind it. Two generator refusals the vectors' own $comment names as inexpressible here: cycles: [] and a variants array longer than PAL_MAX_VARIANTS.
